verdicts.reason: Both shrink the yellow date card (the original's key event info, SAT 22 NOV 8PM-1AM) to an illegible thumbnail. Both also put the CTA in a left column before the headline, so the reading order is broken, and they crop the bottom pattern into an arbitrary right panel. A also shrinks the controller to a speck, and its eyebrow, date card, CTA and body copy are scattered down the left column with no grouping. B is slightly less bad: the controller is still readable and sits with the body copy on one line under the headline, though its date card floats alone below the CTA.
